title: Alonzo Bodden: Historically Incorrect
description: The comic discusses historical inaccuracies, and exposes the hypocrisy of modern-day culture in a humorous way.

title: Corey Rodrigues: People Whisperer
description: Corey is a national touring college, club, corporate, and cruise ship performer.

title: Greg Fitzsimmons: Life on Stage
description: Greg Fitzsimmons discusses the joys of life as a baby; how to get a man to do anything you want; an explanation of how we flaunt our good fortune as a nation through water parks.

title: Jay Mohr: American Treasure
description: Comedian Jay Mohr shares hilarious observations and personal glimpses into his life.

title: Jay Mohr: Altamont
description: Comic Jay Mohr tackles subjects ranging from unexpected visitors to bringing up children and working with Chris Farley on "Saturday Night Live."

title: Karen Morgan: Go Dawgs!
description: A former trial attorney, she moved from the courtroom to comedy after being selected as a finalist on Nickelodeon TV's "Search for the Funniest Mom in America."

title: Danny Martinello: Starting Sober
description: Danny Martinello's debut special dedicated to those who had his back when he decided to put down the bottle.

title: Eddie Izzard: Circle
description: The show that launched Eddie Izzard's Hollywood career and a seminal performance from one of the foremost stand-ups of his generation recorded live in New York City's Town Hall.

title: Josh Blue: Delete
description: In his hometown of Denver, Josh Blue discusses the daily details of his life.

title: Josh Blue: The Disabled List
description: Josh Blue presents a hilarious stand-up act centered on a popular form of alternative treatment, some disability-related topics, and the controversy about the American Paralympics team.

title: Kevin Smith: Silent But Deadly Extended Edition
description: Kevin Smith is anything but quiet in this new comedy special that was recorded an hour before his heart attack in February; before he nearly died backstage, onstage he discusses his marriage, his kid and his work (or lack thereof).

title: Lavell Crawford: I Could Eat - Part 1
description: Lavell Crawford is back and here to contemplate how "My 600 Pound Life" could go for 15 seasons and he was still underweight, the kind of racist you have to be to not take a free holiday, and explosive consequences in a Taco Bell bathroom.

title: Lavell Crawford I Could Eat Part 2
description: Meat's on the menu with Lavell Crawford keeping Burger King humble to their have it your way slogan, godless vegetarians, and why the best chicken is from a house of God.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E01 — Queen Bee
Dracula infiltrates the Queen Bee's hive in an effort to thwart a worldwide bee invasion.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E02 — Mr. Mephisto
Confusion abounds when Mr. Mephisto replaces Mayor Goldwyn with a lookalike doll who spouts off radical opinions.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E03 — The Tickler
The Tickler passes off counterfeit bills in an attempt to lure the Monster Squad into a trap.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E04 — The Ringmaster
The Ringmaster holds children hostage as part of a larger scheme to buy out and close down all the toy stores in America.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E05 — Music Man
Frank and Dracula sign up for music lessons in an attempt to foil the mad musicians who robbed a telethon.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E06 — No Face
Mayor Goldwyn gives the city deed to Chief Running Nose.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E07 — The Astrologer
The Astrologer announces that an earthquake is about to devastate the land, and to make his prediction true, he plans to detonate an atomic bomb.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E08 — Ultra Witch
Ultra Witch dries up the world's milk supply, but she exposes herself by sending a henchman out for cookies.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E09 — The Wizard
The Wizard plans to steal all of the national monuments for his own exhibit.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E10 — The Skull
The Skull decides to resurrect all of the world's villains, beginning with a mummy.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E11 — The Weatherman
The Weatherman causes a national blizzard in the middle of summer and demands that U.S. citizens unanimously elect him president.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E12 — Lawrence of Moravia
Frank and Bruce are captured by a sheik who's been stealing plumbing supplies just for the thrill of it.

title: Monster Squad
description:
S01 E13 — Albert/Alberta
Albert/Alberta begins to flood the world, he/she attempts to gather a collection of animals, which is missing a werewolf and a vampire.

title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
description: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: Freezing Hot
description: Smart and brazen comedian Iliza Shlesinger applies her fresh perspective to the universal struggles between men and women.

title: Tom Segura: Completely Normal
description: Comedian Tom Segura opens up about hotels, his hobbies and digestive ailments.

title: Yakov Smirnoff: What A Country
description: Yakov Smirnoff delivers his unique brand of humor in this stand-up comedy.

title: Tim Allen Rewires America
description: The comedian performs in Ann Arbor, Mich.

title: Tim Allen: Men Are Pigs
description: The comedian examines man's obsession with hardware at the State Theater in Kalamazoo, Mich.

title: Susan Rice: Silver Alert
description: With decades of stand-up experience under her belt, Susan Rice takes the stage to share quips about car troubles and the joys of getting older.

title: Sinbad: Make Me Wanna Holla
description: Comic Sinbad discusses the life advice his family gave him; why he's tired of people with no talent having clothing lines; who he really is.

title: Sinbad: Where U Been?
description: The comic performs at the Club Nokia Theatre in Los Angeles.

title: Nick DiPaolo: Raw Nerve
description: The comic performs.

title: Nick Cannon: Stand Up, Don't Shoot
description: The comic reflects on the times we live in, aging and dating, and the trip to Australia that broke his marriage; from the Ebony Repertory Theatre in South Central Los Angeles.

title: Margaret Cho: psyCHO
description: The comic tackles off-limits issues including Boko Haram, racism and her own sexuality.

title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
description: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
description: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
description: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: Hot and Fluffy
description: Filmed at the Fox Theater in Bakersfield, California the comedian and well-known favorite to television viewers as being on "Last Comic Standing," performs impressions and silly voices.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: Aloha Fluffy
description: The comic discusses his crazy world of family, friends, and world travels.

title: Pete Correale: Let Me Tell Ya
description: Stand-up comic Pete Correale delves into the absurdities of life, love and marriage with his homegrown New Yorker wit.

title: Aries Spears: Comedy Blueprint
description: Armed with his ferociously aggressive style of comedy, MAD TV alum Aries Spears takes the stage in Philadelphia for 'Comedy Blueprint.' No one - not black, not white, not gay, not straight - is safe from his jokes and impressions.

title: Chris Porter: A Man From Kansas
description: Chris Porter discusses everything from hipsters ruining food, to being a man, to playing beer pong with celebrities, in his 3rd one-hour special.

title: Jeff Dunham: I'm With Cupid
description: Ventriloquist and stand-up comedian Jeff Dunham performs an all-Valentine's Day-themed special.

title: Jimmy O. Yang: Good Deal
description: From the Neptune Theater in Seattle, the comic talks about his interactions with immigrant parents, gives his thoughts on Matt Damon and asks whether ghosts are likely to haunt one-bedroom apartments.

title: Jimmy O. Yang: Guess How Much?
description: Yang dives into love languages, loser friends and negotiating with his Asian parents.

title: Tom Papa: Live in New York City
description: Tom Papa discusses his life and kids; worst roommates.

title: SXSW Comedy With Natasha Leggero
description: Stand-up performances include Baron Vaughn, Andrew Santino, Emily Heller, James Adomian and Moshe Kasher; Natasha Leggero hosts; the SXSW festival in Austin, Texas.

title: SXSW Comedy With Natasha Leggero Part 2
description: The performing comics include Emo Phillips, Sean Patton, Ian Edwards, Kurt Braunohler and Eliza Skinner.

title: Sam Tallent: Waiting for Death to Claim Us
description: Follows stand-up scion Sam Tallent through 13 different venues across the US from sold-out theaters to house parties and rib-joints, all the while COVID barrels down on the nation in early 2020.

title: Mark Christopher Lawrence: Clean Outta Compton
description: Comedian Mark Christopher Lawrence performs.

title: Kevin Hart Presents: Lil Rel Howery: RELevent
description: Comic Lil Rel Howery explains how he found out that his father wasn't a doctor; the difference between raising a son and a daughter; racism within the black community.

title: Kathleen Madigan: Madigan Again
description: Kathleen Madigan performs comedy in Detroit.

title: Gary Owen: #DoinWhatIDo
description: Comic Gary Owen bridges the lanes of black and white cultures as only he can, both in his home and on social media.

title: Gary Owen: Breakin' Out the Park
description: Comic Gary Owen discusses his history of growing up in and around trailer parks during a live performance.

title: D.L. Hughley: Clear
description: The comic performs in San Francisco, discussing current affairs and nosy neighbors at the Regency Theater.

title: D.L. Hughley: Reset
description: The comic performs.

title: Iliza Shlesinger: War Paint
description: Iliza Shlesinger performs her first stand-up special in her hometown of Dallas, Texas.

title: Jenny McCarthy's Dirty Sexy Funny
description: Female comedians Paula Bel, Tiffany Haddish, Lynne Koplitz, Justine Marino and Tammy Pescatelli join Jenny McCarthy to shed some light on what it's really like to be a woman.

title: Jim Gaffigan: The Pale Tourist - Canadian American
description: Jim Gaffigan performs in Canada and has some very strong opinions on poutine, Saskatchewan, health care and the pronunciation of the city of Regina.

title: Bill Engvall: Here's Your Sign: It's Finally Time: My Last Show
description: Bill Engvall, renowned comedian, entertains audiences for the last time.

title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
description: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

title: Pete Correale: The Things We Do For Love
description: The comic performs.

title: Arnez J: Racially Motivated
description: A comedy performance by Arnez J at Boston's Wilbur Theater.

title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
description: A live concert performance that leans heavily on four favorite characters; cranky old man Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, the mischievous purple whatsit and Peanut.

title: Whitney Cummings: Money Shot
description: One of the funniest comics on television.

title: Andy Sandford: &y S&ford
description: Andy Sandford dives into the absurd side of life, tackling pharmacists losing their jobs, full-sized houses on the move, and clowns on the edge. Smart, dry, and brutally funny-this is stand-up for people who notice how weird the world really is.

title: Bill Hicks: Reflections
description: Comedy Dynamics sits down with Bill Hicks' brother, Steve, who tells old stories, squashes old rumors and reveals the brother and son behind the late comedian. Told amidst old and rare footage of Bill.

title: Bill Hicks: One Night Stand
description: Bill Hicks offers his unique take on smoking cigarettes, smoking pot, drinking, sex, advertising and music.

title: Bob Saget: That's What I'm Talkin' About
description: Bob Saget takes to the stage with a filthy song in his heart as he lets loose and embraces the dark side as he tells his favorite dirty jokes and stories about his dad - the guy who made him like this.

title: Bob Saget: Zero to Sixty
description: Bob Saget declares himself to be the last TV father viewers can trust in his hour of entertaining stories, riffing with the audience, words of wisdom and new original comedy songs.

title: Eddie Griffin: Undeniable
description: The comic celebrates a 30-year anniversary in comedy by discussing the world, relationships and humanity.

title: Eddie Griffin: You Can Tell Em I Said It
description: Eddie shares his thoughts on his love for Michelle Obama, God's sense of humor, who really makes up the Tea Party, and why Cleveland should get over LeBron James.

title: Ilana Glazer: The Planet Is Burning
description: The comic shares her thoughts on homophobes, Nazis, women's razors, and what a joke the patriarchy is.

title: Jim Gaffigan: Quality Time
description: The comic uses his signature everyman humor to deal with the unthinkable; filmed at the State Theatre in Minneapolis.

title: Jim Gaffigan: Noble Ape
description: Comic Jim Gaffigan proves that laughter is the best medicine when he talks about a family medical crisis and other topics during his hilarious stand-up routine.

description: Ventriloquist and stand-up comedian Jeff Dunham performs an all-Valentine's Day-themed special.
